_about: Market numbers for each area guide, from Ryth's MLS. Leave a guide at null and its 'Market numbers' section stays hidden. To fill one, replace null with: { "median": 315000, "sold": 412, "dom": 45, "scope": "Single-family homes and condos sold in Stroud Township, Stroudsburg and East Stroudsburg", "period": "October 2025 to September 2026", "source": "Pocono Mountains MLS, pulled October 2026" } (median = median sale price, sold = homes sold in the last 12 months, dom = average days on market).
